Concurrent retry/delivery of an initial credential sync can both see no row and create duplicates; later reruns update one arbitrary `findFirst` row while the others retain stale credentials. adjudication.rationale: The diff shows a new webhook endpoint at apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts that uses findFirst to check for existing credentials, then either updates or creates. Lines 62-70 show `prisma.credential.findFirst` followed by conditional update/create at lines 72-90. This is a classic TOCTOU race condition - if two concurrent webhook deliveries arrive for the same userId/appId combination when no credential exists, both will see no existing credential and both will create new records, resulting in duplicate credentials. The code lacks any transaction wrapper, unique constraint enforcement, or upsert pattern that would prevent this race condition.
